Definition: of Hebrew origin (H121); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative):--Adam.
BiblicalUsage: Adam the man — the first man, who named every living creature, whose generations are written in 'the book of the generations of Adam,' and who lived nine hundred and thirty years and died; Paul calls him 'the figure of him that was to come,' setting the first man against Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: The first man is the head of a fallen race, and the pattern of the One to come. I hold that as the Bible holds it: Adam's story is our story, and Christ's story is the answer to it.
RelatedTopics: Adam and Eve; The Fall; Creation
